title: Configured lint rejects the /tokens dependency signature
reasoning: The project lint command selects flake8-bugbear, and `python -m ruff check --no-cache app/api/auth.py` reports B008 on this route because `Depends(get_session)` is called in a default argument. That makes the owned file fail the configured release check unless this FastAPI dependency style is converted to an `Annotated` dependency or B008 is explicitly ignored for the project.
reproduction: Run `python -m ruff check --no-cache app/api/auth.py`; Ruff reports B008 at app/api/auth.py:244.
recommendation: Change the session parameter to `session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]` with no default, applying the same pattern consistently where this file needs to pass lint, or explicitly configure Ruff to ignore B008 for FastAPI dependency declarations.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked feature lists no tests, and ordinary pytest route tests would not catch lint-gate failures unless the lint command is part of CI.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add the configured lint command to CI for this package, or at minimum run `ruff check app/api/auth.py` in the release gate.
minimumFixScope: Update the `list_api_tokens` dependency declaration and any sibling declarations required for `app/api/auth.py` to pass the configured Ruff rules.
